name: QQ bot
description: Connect QQ groups and private chats to Claude: members @ the bot or use a prefix, and answers go back to QQ. Each group gets its own sandbox (no shell, no access to host files); no extra account or multi-user mode needed. Works with NapCat or any OneBot 11 endpoint.

mode.label: Endpoint (NapCat)
mode.desc: "Already running" = you start NapCat yourself; "Started by bridge" = bridge starts it while the plugin is on, restarts it on crash or QQ logout, and stops it with the plugin.

napcatDir.label: NapCat folder
napcatDir.desc: The unpacked NapCat.Shell folder. If it has its own node.exe and index.js they are used directly; otherwise the start script below runs.

napcatQQ.label: Quick-login QQ number
napcatQQ.desc: Log in this account without scanning (it must have scanned once before). Empty = scan every time.

napcatScript.label: Start script
napcatScript.desc: Only used when the folder has no node.exe + index.js. File name relative to the folder.

apiUrl.label: OneBot HTTP address
apiUrl.desc: NapCat's "HTTP server" address (used to send messages).

apiToken.label: HTTP server token
apiToken.desc: The token set on NapCat's HTTP server; leave empty if none.

hookToken.label: Report token (optional)
hookToken.desc: The token set on NapCat's "HTTP client". Empty = only accept reports from this machine.

watchdog.label: Watchdog
watchdog.desc: When QQ logs out: "Started by bridge" restarts NapCat to log back in and asks you to scan if that fails; "Already running" only notifies you.

prefix.label: Trigger prefix
prefix.desc: Group messages starting with it get an answer; empty = @ only.

privateReply.label: Answer private chats
privateReply.desc: Friends' private messages need no @ or prefix.

cooldownSec.label: Per-person cooldown (seconds)
cooldownSec.desc: Ignore repeat messages from the same person within this time.

paused.label: Pause answering
paused.desc: Silence the bot for now (group chat is still recorded). Group admins can also send "/ai 暂停" / "/ai 继续".

dailyTurns.label: Max answers per day
dailyTurns.desc: Across all groups and private chats; after that it replies that today's quota is used up. 0 = unlimited. Uses the server's Claude quota.

fast.label: Fast mode
fast.desc: Faster and pricier answers on supported models (Opus).

maxParallel.label: Chats answered at once
maxParallel.desc: One group is always answered in order; different groups can run in parallel.

plainReply.label: Plain-text replies
plainReply.desc: QQ doesn't render Markdown: ask Claude for plain text (files it writes are unaffected).

forward.label: Merged forward
forward.desc: Fold the answer into a "chat history" card instead of flooding the group.

sendFiles.label: Send files to QQ
sendFiles.desc: Files Claude makes: images as pictures, everything else as group / private files.

readImages.label: Read images
readImages.desc: Images in the question and in quoted messages go to Claude too.

chatLog.label: Record group chat for Claude
chatLog.desc: Every group message (with images) is saved by day in the group's sandbox, so Claude can look back when someone says "that one above".

chatImgDays.label: Keep group images (days)
chatImgDays.desc: Older images are removed every night; text is kept. 0 = keep forever.

snapChat.label: "/chat" sends a private chat page
snapChat.desc: When someone @s the bot with "/chat", give them a web link to talk to Claude alone (isolated workspace, closes when idle; needs Chat snapshots on and a public address).

extraPrompt.label: Extra persona / instructions
extraPrompt.desc: Appended to Claude's system prompt, e.g. "Your name is Kai; keep answers short".

admins.label: Admin QQ numbers
admins.desc: Besides group owners / admins, who may use "/ai 重置", "/ai 暂停", "/ai 继续" in groups.

legacyDir.label: Old qq-bot folder
legacyDir.desc: Folder of the old standalone qq-bot (admin page on port 5700). Fill it in, then press "Import from old version" above to bring over settings and each group's chat records (with images).
